lead: Cinematic sci-fi film still in deep space, electric cyan, violet, fiery yellow glow.
notes: Mood-only mini images for StardustAssault.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen StardustAssault-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish StardustAssault-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: invaders
images.prompt: A formation of glowing geometric alien ships, triangles, cubes and rings, flying through space.

images.name: hive
images.prompt: Glowing alien honeycomb tunnels deep inside a hollow planetoid.

images.name: assault
images.prompt: A lone white robot spacecraft diving toward a dark cratered planetoid.

images.name: wave
images.prompt: A swarm of small colorful glowing shapes scattering across a dark starfield.

images.name: core
images.prompt: A huge glowing orb pulsing with light at the heart of an alien cavern.

images.name: gallery
images.prompt: Framed paintings of colorful space nebulas hanging on a dark gallery wall.

images.name: break
images.prompt: A pilot's cockpit at rest, glowing screens and a mug of coffee on the console.

images.name: blast
images.prompt: A slowly expanding ring of fire blooming in the darkness of space.

images.name: shield
images.prompt: A glowing cyan energy shield bubble deflecting bright shots in space.

images.name: swarm
images.prompt: Countless tiny glowing alien ships swarming around one bright white spacecraft.
